Priya (CS): Tidecrest preview (wave D) hit a roadblock: IdP cert mismatch. PM says they can't finish seat invites until that's fixed. renewal window in 3 weeks, marked 'watch'.
Ethan (Enablement): we should offer a short workaround session — 25m? goal: unblock core dev flows so they can validate features.
Noah (SolutionsEng): 25m ok. need their IdP metadata + cert error logs. asked for them yesterday, no reply yet. can we offer a temporary scoped org?
Priya (CS): i'll nudge the PM and mention a temporary org option. will ask for logs and a screenshot of the console error.
Noah (SolutionsEng): temporary org plan: create sandbox org, 5 seats, temp API key scoped to staging, auto-revoke 14 days. include audit logging. we'll need a policy ticket for auto-revoke.
Ethan (Enablement): i'll prepare a 1-slide quickstart: how to run the 3 happy-paths with token, then swap to SSO later. include sample curl + env vars. keep it tight.
Priya (CS): also capture a micro-pulse after the session: "did you run your top-3 flows? yes/no" to get a quick signal.
onboard-bot: Temp org provisioned: https://redwood.example/orgs/tidecrest-staging - seats:5 - token: https://redwood.example/tokens/tide-temp-xyZ - expires 2024-08-01T00:00Z. Audit enabled.
Noah (SolutionsEng): thanks bot. i'll prep a rollback checklist + model suggestion for low-latency eval (small-llm-2q). last time they flagged embedding latency.
Ethan (Enablement): agenda for session: 1) quick cert triage (5m), 2) temp org + token walkthrough (10m), 3) run 3 core flows + pulse (10m). 25m total.
Priya (CS): onboard-bot, create invite for Thu 2024-07-18 14:00 UTC - attendees: Priya (CS), Ethan (Enablement), Noah (SolutionsEng), Tidecrest PM.
onboard-bot: Calendar invite created: Thu 2024-07-18 14:00 UTC - "Tidecrest wave D: rapid preview unblock (25m)" - join link: https://meet.redwood/example/tc123
Priya (CS): next steps: 1) Priya nudge PM for logs/screenshots (ASAP). 2) Ethan finalize slide + pulse (Mon EOD). 3) Noah prepare rollback + model note (Mon EOD). 4) Offer temp org during session if SSO blocked.
Noah (SolutionsEng): ack.
Ethan (Enablement): ack.
Priya (CS): we'll log this as a renewal-mitigation touch so AM knows. ping me if PM uploads artifacts and i'll forward. :thumbsup:
